personal_allowance_and_income_tax_bands_.label: Personal Allowance and rUK Income Tax bands, 2026/27
personal_allowance_and_income_tax_bands_.value: Personal Allowance 12570 GBP (tapered above 100000 GBP, 1 GBP per 2 GBP, reaching 0 at 125140 GBP); 20% to 50270 GBP; 40% to 125140 GBP; 45% above
personal_allowance_and_income_tax_bands_.source_name: House of Commons Library / GOV.UK aggregated guidance

national_insurance_class1_2026_27.label: Class 1 National Insurance rates and thresholds, 2026/27
national_insurance_class1_2026_27.value: Employee: 8% between Primary Threshold (12570 GBP/year) and Upper Earnings Limit (50270 GBP/year), 2% above. Employer: 15% above Secondary Threshold (5000 GBP/year), no upper limit.
national_insurance_class1_2026_27.source_name: GOV.UK, Rates and allowances: National Insurance contributions

full_time_hours_convention.label: 37.5 hours/week as the most commonly cited UK full-time benchmark
full_time_hours_convention.note: The UK has no single statutory full-time weekly-hours figure; 37.5h/week is the most frequently cited standard (9-to-5 with an unpaid lunch break).

auto_enrolment_qualifying_earnings_2026_.label: Automatic enrolment qualifying earnings band and earnings trigger, 2026/27
auto_enrolment_qualifying_earnings_2026_.value: Lower limit 6240 GBP/year, upper limit 50270 GBP/year, earnings trigger 10000 GBP/year (unchanged from 2025/26)
auto_enrolment_qualifying_earnings_2026_.source_name: UK Parliament written statement (Pensions Minister, 18 December 2025) / CIPP

auto_enrolment_minimum_contribution_rate.label: Automatic enrolment statutory minimum contribution rates
auto_enrolment_minimum_contribution_rate.value: 8% of qualifying earnings total, at least 3% employer (Pensions Act 2008 and subsequent phasing regulations, unchanged since April 2019)
